conferenceVenues: Sheraton New York Times Square Hotel
photoSpots: Top of the Rock at Rockefeller Center
new-york-city-ny.blurb: New York's calendar is driven by finance, media, fashion and tech, with major trade shows at the Javits Center and a steady run of galas, product launches and hotel-ballroom weddings across all five boroughs. Spring and fall bring the best outdoor light and the busiest booking season, while permits and crowd timing matter for shoots at landmark parks and bridges.

conferenceVenues: JW Marriott Los Angeles L.A. LIVE
eventVenues: Los Angeles County Museum of Art (LACMA)
los-angeles-ca.blurb: Entertainment, media and design shape LA's event scene, from studio premieres and award-season parties to trade shows at the convention center downtown. The dry, mild climate allows outdoor shoots most of the year, though traffic between neighborhoods should be built into any multi-location timeline.

chicago-il.blurb: Chicago hosts some of the country's largest trade shows at McCormick Place, alongside a busy corporate, healthcare and food-industry meeting market downtown. Summer and early fall are peak season for lakefront and rooftop events, while winter work moves indoors to museums and historic hotel ballrooms.

conferenceVenues: New York Marriott at the Brooklyn Bridge
Duggal Greenhouse at the Brooklyn Navy Yard
brooklyn-ny.blurb: Brooklyn's event scene leans toward converted industrial spaces, waterfront venues and creative-industry gatherings, with brand activations and design events alongside a large wedding market. Late spring and fall are the most popular windows for waterfront portraits with the Manhattan skyline behind them.

photoSpots: Hermann Park and its Japanese Garden
houston-tx.blurb: Energy, healthcare and aerospace drive Houston's conference market, including the large Offshore Technology Conference each spring at NRG Park. Summers are hot and humid with an active hurricane season, so outdoor sessions are best planned for October through April or early in the morning.

photoSpots: Unisphere in Flushing Meadows Corona Park
queens-ny.blurb: Queens is home to both of New York City's major airports, which makes it a practical base for airport-hotel meetings, and its diverse communities support a large banquet-hall and multicultural wedding scene. Gantry Plaza and Hunters Point offer skyline views across the East River, best at sunset.

philadelphia-pa.blurb: Philadelphia's meetings market is anchored by healthcare, pharmaceuticals and universities, with conventions centered on the Pennsylvania Convention Center downtown. Colonial-era streets and Fairmount Park give event and wedding photographers historic backdrops within a short drive, and spring and fall are the most comfortable seasons outdoors.

conferenceVenues: JW Marriott Phoenix Desert Ridge Resort & Spa
phoenix-az.blurb: Phoenix's resort properties make it a common destination for incentive trips and corporate retreats, with conference and wedding season concentrated from October through April. Summer temperatures regularly top 100°F, so outdoor shoots in those months are usually scheduled around sunrise or golden hour.

manhattan-ny.blurb: Manhattan concentrates the city's corporate headquarters, media companies and luxury hotels, so it sees a dense schedule of conferences, investor events, fashion-week shows and black-tie galas. Shooting outdoors means planning around crowds and permit rules, with early mornings in Central Park and the High Line being the quietest.

conferenceVenues: Grand Hyatt San Antonio River Walk
JW Marriott San Antonio Hill Country Resort & Spa
san-antonio-tx.blurb: San Antonio draws association conventions and military and healthcare meetings to its River Walk hotels, and the city's Spanish missions and historic homes are popular for weddings. Fiesta in April fills the calendar, and long, hot summers make spring and late fall the preferred seasons for outdoor sessions.

san-diego-ca.blurb: San Diego hosts Comic-Con each July along with major biotech, defense and medical meetings at its bayfront convention center. The coastal climate is mild year-round, though marine layer clouds in May and June can flatten morning light near the beaches.

photoSpots: Wave Hill gardens overlooking the Hudson
Pelham Bay Park and Orchard Beach
the-bronx-ny.blurb: The Bronx's event scene centers on its large cultural institutions and waterfront banquet halls, with the botanical garden and Wave Hill both well established as wedding and gala sites. Spring bloom season and fall foliage are the strongest times for garden portraits.

conferenceVenues: Kay Bailey Hutchison Convention Center Dallas
Irving Convention Center at Las Colinas
eventVenues: Perot Museum of Nature and Science
dallas-tx.blurb: Dallas has a large corporate-headquarters base in finance, telecom and energy, which keeps its convention center and hotel ballrooms busy with meetings and award events. Spring is a popular season for weddings, while summer heat pushes most outdoor shoots to early morning or evening.

photoSpots: Japanese Friendship Garden at Kelley Park
san-jose-ca.blurb: As the largest city in Silicon Valley, San Jose sees a steady flow of tech conferences, developer events and product launches, plus corporate offsites in nearby Santa Clara. The dry, mild climate makes outdoor sessions practical most of the year, with the Municipal Rose Garden peaking from April through June.

photoSpots: Lady Bird Lake and the Ann and Roy Butler Hike-and-Bike Trail
austin-tx.blurb: Austin's event calendar is shaped by tech companies, the University of Texas and festivals such as SXSW in March and Austin City Limits in the fall. With the downtown convention center closed for a multi-year rebuild, more meetings are landing in large hotels and university venues, and spring wildflower season is a favorite for portraits before summer heat sets in.

photoSpots: Friendship Fountain on the Southbank Riverwalk
jacksonville-fl.blurb: Jacksonville's meetings market draws on logistics, finance, healthcare and a large military presence, while nearby Ponte Vedra Beach hosts golf-centered corporate events around THE PLAYERS Championship each March. Summers are hot and humid with afternoon storms, so spring and fall are the most dependable seasons for beach and riverfront shoots.

conferenceVenues: Fort Mason Center for Arts & Culture
photoSpots: Golden Gate Bridge from Crissy Field
san-francisco-ca.blurb: San Francisco's conference calendar is dominated by tech and software events at Moscone Center, and City Hall is one of the most photographed civil-wedding locations in the country. Summer fog is common near the coast, so September and October often bring the clearest, warmest days for outdoor work.

eventVenues: Franklin Park Conservatory and Botanical Gardens
columbus-oh.blurb: Columbus combines state government, Ohio State University and a growing insurance, retail and tech sector, which supports a steady flow of conventions and association meetings downtown. The Arnold Sports Festival fills the city each March, and fall foliage around German Village and the Scioto Mile is a popular backdrop.

eventVenues: Modern Art Museum of Fort Worth
photoSpots: Japanese Garden at the Fort Worth Botanic Garden
fort-worth-tx.blurb: Fort Worth mixes Western heritage with a strong museum district, and the Fort Worth Stock Show & Rodeo each January and February is one of its biggest annual draws. Ranch-style and Stockyards weddings are common, and spring and fall avoid the worst of North Texas summer heat.

photoSpots: Indianapolis Cultural Trail and Canal Walk
indianapolis-in.blurb: Indianapolis has a compact, walkable convention district connected to hotels by skywalks, and it hosts Gen Con each summer along with frequent amateur and pro sports events. May is dominated by the Indianapolis 500, while autumn is a good season for outdoor portraits along the canal and in the city's parks.

conferenceVenues: The Ballantyne, a Luxury Collection Hotel
charlotte-nc.blurb: As a major banking center with a large hub airport, Charlotte sees a steady stream of financial-services meetings, corporate events and motorsports-related gatherings. Mild springs and autumns suit outdoor weddings, and the tree-lined streets of Myers Park and Dilworth are common portrait settings.

eventVenues: Smithsonian National Museum of the American Indian
washington-dc.blurb: Washington's event market is built around government, policy associations, nonprofits and embassies, so conferences, advocacy fly-ins and evening receptions run year-round. Cherry blossom season in late March and early April is the busiest time for portraits around the Tidal Basin, and permits are required for some shoots on the National Mall.

seattle-wa.blurb: Seattle's conference scene is driven by cloud computing, software, aerospace and life sciences, with major events at the downtown convention center and corporate gatherings in Bellevue. Summers are dry and long-lit, while the rest of the year brings soft overcast light and frequent drizzle, so backup indoor locations are standard practice.

conferenceVenues: Hyatt Regency Denver at Colorado Convention Center
The Brown Palace Hotel and Spa
denver-co.blurb: Denver's central location and large hub airport make it a frequent pick for national association meetings, while the nearby Rockies draw mountain weddings and corporate retreats. Weather changes quickly, with afternoon thunderstorms in summer and the chance of snow from October into spring, so flexible scheduling helps for outdoor shoots.

photoSpots: Ysleta Mission on the Mission Trail
el-paso-tx.blurb: El Paso's event scene reflects its border location, Fort Bliss military community and close ties with Ciudad Juárez, with bilingual weddings and quinceañeras a large part of the market. The high-desert climate brings abundant sun, and the Franklin Mountains provide sunset and city-light backdrops for portraits.

conferenceVenues: Detroit Marriott at the Renaissance Center
detroit-mi.blurb: The auto industry anchors Detroit's meetings and trade-show market, including the Detroit Auto Show at Huntington Place, and restored historic buildings downtown have become popular for galas and weddings. Summer and early fall are the prime outdoor seasons along the riverfront, while winters are cold and gray.

conferenceVenues: Omni Boston Hotel at the Seaport
boston-ma.blurb: Boston's universities, hospitals and biotech firms generate a dense calendar of academic and medical conferences, concentrated in the Seaport. Fall foliage season is the most requested time for portraits, while winters bring snow and early sunsets that shorten outdoor windows.

memphis-tn.blurb: Memphis is a logistics and healthcare hub, home to FedEx's global headquarters and St. Jude Children's Research Hospital, which keeps corporate and medical meetings steady. Music history drives much of its tourism, including Memphis in May each spring, and summers are hot and humid enough that evening shoots are often preferred.

conferenceVenues: Hyatt Regency Portland at the Oregon Convention Center
photoSpots: Cathedral Park under the St. Johns Bridge
portland-or.blurb: Portland's event scene leans toward outdoor apparel, design and food-and-drink industries, with many couples and companies choosing nearby Willamette Valley wineries or the Columbia River Gorge. Dry, mild summers are peak season, while the rainy months from November through March bring soft light and lush green backdrops.

oklahoma-city-ok.blurb: Energy, aviation and state government anchor Oklahoma City's meetings market, which has grown with the convention center and Omni hotel that opened beside Scissortail Park. Spring brings severe-weather season, so outdoor events from April through June benefit from a covered backup, while fall is typically the most settled time to shoot.

eventVenues: The Smith Center for the Performing Arts
photoSpots: Welcome to Fabulous Las Vegas sign
Red Rock Canyon National Conservation Area
las-vegas-nv.blurb: Las Vegas is one of the busiest trade-show cities in North America, hosting CES each January along with a long list of industry expos across its resort convention spaces. It is also a major wedding destination, and the desert backdrops nearby are best shot from fall through spring, as summer afternoons are extremely hot.

baltimore-md.blurb: Baltimore's meetings scene leans on medicine and research tied to Johns Hopkins and the University of Maryland, along with the city's port and logistics businesses. Waterfront neighborhoods with cobblestone streets and rowhouses offer historic backdrops, and spring and fall avoid the humid mid-Atlantic summer.

milwaukee-wi.blurb: Milwaukee's manufacturing and brewing heritage shows up in its event venues, many of them restored warehouses and Gilded Age buildings, and the expanded Baird Center has added convention capacity downtown. Summer is festival season along the Lake Michigan shoreline, including Summerfest, while winters are long and cold.

eventVenues: Los Poblanos Historic Inn & Organic Farm
albuquerque-nm.blurb: Albuquerque's event market includes national-lab and aerospace meetings, Native American and Hispanic cultural celebrations, and the International Balloon Fiesta each October. The high-desert light is strong and clear, and the Sandia Mountains turn pink at sunset, making evening the favored time for outdoor portraits.

conferenceVenues: JW Marriott Tucson Starr Pass Resort
The Westin La Paloma Resort & Spa
Hilton Tucson El Conquistador Golf & Tennis Resort
tucson-az.blurb: Tucson's event calendar features the University of Arizona, aerospace and optics companies, and the Tucson Gem and Mineral Show, which fills the city every January and February. Saguaro-filled desert and foothill resorts make it a popular wedding destination from October through April, with summer monsoon storms arriving in July and August.

eventVenues: Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum
nashville-tn.blurb: Nashville's music industry and large healthcare-management sector keep its convention center and hotels busy, and the city is one of the most popular destinations in the country for bachelorette parties and weddings. Spring and fall are peak seasons, with humid summers and occasional winter ice.

conferenceVenues: DoubleTree by Hilton Fresno Convention Center
photoSpots: Woodward Park and Shinzen Friendship Garden
fresno-ca.blurb: Fresno sits at the center of the San Joaquin Valley's agriculture industry, which drives many of its trade meetings and expos, and it is a common gateway for Yosemite, Kings Canyon and Sequoia. The Blossom Trail peaks in late February and March, while summer heat pushes outdoor shoots to early morning or evening.

sacramento-ca.blurb: As California's capital, Sacramento hosts a steady schedule of government, policy and association meetings, and it promotes itself as a farm-to-fork dining city. Nearby Lodi, Amador County and the Sierra foothills draw winery weddings, and the long, dry summers are hot enough that golden hour is the preferred shooting window.

conferenceVenues: Sheraton Kansas City Hotel at Crown Center
eventVenues: Kauffman Center for the Performing Arts
The Grand Hall at Power & Light
kansas-city-mo.blurb: Kansas City's meetings market draws on agriculture, engineering, logistics and animal health, and its central location makes it a practical choice for national associations. The city's fountains and the Spanish-inspired Country Club Plaza are popular portrait settings, with spring and fall the most comfortable seasons.

long-beach-ca.blurb: Long Beach combines a major port with a waterfront convention district, and it hosts the Grand Prix of Long Beach street race each April. Mild coastal weather allows year-round outdoor shoots, with harbor and canal settings that work well at sunset.

conferenceVenues: Sheraton Mesa Hotel at Wrigleyville West
mesa-az.blurb: Mesa is the largest city in the Phoenix East Valley and hosts Chicago Cubs spring training at Sloan Park each February and March, which brings a wave of visitors and corporate hospitality events. The Superstition Mountains and Salt River are close by for desert portraits, best scheduled from October through April.

conferenceVenues: Hilton Garden Inn New York/Staten Island
Snug Harbor Cultural Center & Botanical Garden
eventVenues: Snug Harbor Cultural Center & Botanical Garden
photoSpots: New York Chinese Scholar's Garden at Snug Harbor
St. George waterfront and Staten Island Ferry
staten-island-ny.blurb: Staten Island's event market is largely local, built around catering halls, family celebrations and community events, with Snug Harbor's restored buildings and gardens as a frequent wedding choice. Its waterfront parks offer harbor and Verrazzano-Narrows Bridge views, and the free ferry makes Lower Manhattan an easy add-on location.

conferenceVenues: Omni Atlanta Hotel at Centennial Park
eventVenues: Swan House at the Atlanta History Center
atlanta-ga.blurb: Atlanta's huge hub airport and large downtown convention campus make it a top destination for trade shows, and it is home to corporate headquarters in logistics, media and beverages as well as a busy film-production industry. Spring dogwood and azalea season and mild autumns are favored for outdoor sessions, while summers are hot and humid.

eventVenues: Colorado Springs Fine Arts Center at Colorado College
colorado-springs-co.blurb: Colorado Springs has a strong military and defense presence along with the U.S. Olympic & Paralympic Training Center, which shapes many of its conferences and ceremonies. Red-rock and mountain backdrops make it a popular wedding destination, though afternoon summer storms and early-season snow call for flexible timing.

photoSpots: Virginia Beach Boardwalk and King Neptune statue
virginia-beach-va.blurb: Virginia Beach's event scene combines oceanfront tourism with a large military community tied to the Hampton Roads naval and joint bases, which supports reunions, ceremonies and defense-industry meetings. Beach weddings peak from late spring through early fall, and early mornings or evenings help avoid crowds and midday glare on the sand.

eventVenues: Martin Marietta Center for the Performing Arts
raleigh-nc.blurb: Raleigh anchors the Research Triangle, so its event calendar leans on tech, life sciences, state government and university conferences, alongside a busy wedding market spread between downtown venues and countryside estates. Spring and fall bring mild weather and blooming or turning trees, while humid summer afternoons often call for early or golden-hour outdoor sessions.

conferenceVenues: Omaha Marriott Downtown at the Capitol District
Embassy Suites by Hilton Omaha La Vista Hotel & Conference Center
eventVenues: Omaha's Henry Doorly Zoo and Aquarium
photoSpots: Gene Leahy Mall at The RiverFront
omaha-ne.blurb: Omaha draws insurance, finance, rail and agribusiness meetings, and it hosts the annual Berkshire Hathaway shareholders meeting and the NCAA Men's College World Series. Winters are cold and snowy, so many weddings and outdoor shoots cluster between May and October, with indoor museum and ballroom venues carrying the off-season.

conferenceVenues: Hyatt Regency Miami and James L. Knight Center
eventVenues: Adrienne Arsht Center for the Performing Arts
miami-fl.blurb: Miami's calendar is shaped by international business, finance, art and hospitality, with Art Basel Miami Beach each December and a steady run of Latin American corporate meetings and destination weddings. The dry season from roughly November to April is peak time for events; summer brings heat, humidity, daily storms and hurricane-season planning.

oakland-ca.blurb: Oakland's events mix tech and nonprofit gatherings, arts and music happenings, and weddings that take advantage of historic theaters, gardens and the hills above the city. The climate is mild year-round with drier, sunnier days than San Francisco, though morning fog and a rainy season from about November to March are worth building into shoot plans.

minneapolis-mn.blurb: Minneapolis is home to major retail, healthcare, medical device and financial companies, which keeps its convention center and downtown hotels busy with corporate meetings and trade events. Summers are short and lush with the city's lakes and riverfront at their best, while long, cold winters push most events indoors to converted warehouses, museums and ballrooms.

eventVenues: Tulsa Garden Center at Woodward Park
tulsa-ok.blurb: Tulsa's meetings market grew out of the energy and aerospace industries, and the city now pairs those with arts events, music venues and weddings in its Art Deco downtown. Spring and fall offer the most comfortable outdoor conditions, while summers are hot and spring storms can force quick changes to outdoor plans.

conferenceVenues: Century II Performing Arts & Convention Center
wichita-ks.airport: Wichita Dwight D. Eisenhower National Airport (ICT)
wichita-ks.blurb: Known as the Air Capital of the World, Wichita hosts many aviation and manufacturing meetings, plus regional association events and a steady local wedding scene. Outdoor work is most comfortable in spring and fall; summers are hot and windy, and spring brings severe-weather risk.

photoSpots: City Park and the Besthoff Sculpture Garden
new-orleans-la.airport: Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport (MSY)
new-orleans-la.blurb: New Orleans is a major convention city and hosts large festivals such as Mardi Gras, Jazz Fest and Essence Festival, plus destination weddings with second-line parades through historic streets. The most comfortable season runs from late fall through spring; summers are hot and humid with frequent afternoon storms, and hurricane season runs June through November.

conferenceVenues: Loews Arlington Hotel and Convention Center
photoSpots: University of Texas at Arlington campus
arlington-tx.blurb: Arlington sits between Dallas and Fort Worth and is best known for its entertainment district, home to AT&T Stadium, Globe Life Field and Six Flags Over Texas, which draws major sporting events, concerts and corporate hospitality. Spring and fall are the sweet spots for outdoor sessions, since North Texas summers regularly run past 100°F.

conferenceVenues: Cleveland Marriott Downtown at Key Tower
cleveland-oh.blurb: Cleveland's event scene is tied to healthcare, manufacturing and higher education, with the Cleveland Clinic and University Circle institutions generating a steady stream of medical and academic meetings. Lake Erie brings pleasant summers and colorful falls but snowy, gray winters, so indoor museum and historic hotel venues are popular from November to March.

conferenceVenues: Dignity Health Theater and Convention Center
Bakersfield Marriott at the Convention Center
bakersfield-ca.blurb: Bakersfield's economy runs on agriculture and energy, and the city is known for the country-music Bakersfield Sound, which shows up in venues like Buck Owens' Crystal Palace. Summers are very hot and dry, so outdoor shoots work best in spring and fall or near sunrise and sunset, and winter can bring tule fog.

conferenceVenues: Hilton Hawaiian Village Waikiki Beach Resort
Hyatt Regency Waikiki Beach Resort and Spa
eventVenues: The Royal Hawaiian, a Luxury Collection Resort
Moana Surfrider, A Westin Resort & Spa
photoSpots: Magic Island at Ala Moana Beach Park
honolulu-hi.blurb: Honolulu draws Pacific Rim business meetings, military and government events, incentive trips and a large share of destination weddings. The weather is warm year-round, with trade winds and passing showers, and winter months bring bigger surf on the north and west shores while sunset timing makes beachfront shoots popular any season.

tampa-fl.blurb: Tampa hosts healthcare, defense, finance and sports-related events, along with large Gasparilla celebrations each winter and a busy year-round wedding market. Winter and spring are the most comfortable months for outdoor sessions; summers bring heat, humidity and near-daily afternoon thunderstorms during hurricane season.

aurora-co.blurb: Aurora sits next to Denver International Airport and is home to the Anschutz Medical Campus and several military installations, making it a regular host for medical, aerospace and large association conventions. The high-plains climate brings plenty of sun and dramatic mountain views on clear days, with summer afternoon storms and occasional heavy spring snow to plan around.

anaheim-ca.blurb: Anaheim's convention center is the largest on the West Coast, and the surrounding resort district keeps it busy with trade shows such as the NAMM Show and Natural Products Expo West. Southern California's mild, dry weather allows outdoor shoots most of the year, with the coolest, greenest conditions in winter and spring.

conferenceVenues: Avenue of the Arts Costa Mesa (South Coast Metro)
santa-ana-ca.blurb: As Orange County's seat, Santa Ana hosts government, legal and cultural events, and its museums and historic downtown are popular for galas and weddings with a strong Latino cultural influence. The mild coastal-inland climate makes outdoor shoots possible most of the year, with summer heat and late-spring marine-layer mornings to plan around.

photoSpots: Harbor Bridge views from North Beach
corpus-christi-tx.blurb: Corpus Christi's events are tied to its port, energy and petrochemical industries, naval presence and Gulf Coast tourism, and beach and bayfront weddings are common. Winters are mild and good for outdoor shoots, while summers are hot and humid with steady coastal winds and a June-to-November hurricane season.

conferenceVenues: Marriott Riverside at the Convention Center
eventVenues: The Cheech Marin Center for Chicano Art & Culture
photoSpots: Mission Inn and Downtown Main Street Mall
riverside-ca.blurb: Riverside's event scene centers on its historic downtown, where the Mission Inn hosts weddings and its Festival of Lights draws crowds each holiday season, while the university and county government bring steady meetings. Inland Empire summers are hot and dry, so spring, fall and winter offer the best outdoor light and comfort.

conferenceVenues: Hyatt Regency St. Louis at The Arch
eventVenues: St. Louis Union Station Grand Hall
photoSpots: Forest Park and the World's Fair Pavilion
st-louis-mo.blurb: St. Louis hosts healthcare, bioscience, agriculture-tech and financial-services meetings, along with large faith-based and sports events, and its historic buildings and gardens are favorite wedding backdrops. Spring and fall are the best seasons for outdoor work; summers are hot and humid and winters can be cold and gray.

eventVenues: Morris Chapel at University of the Pacific
stockton-ca.blurb: Stockton sits on the San Joaquin Delta and draws agriculture, logistics and education events, with nearby Lodi wineries adding to the region's wedding options. Summers are hot and dry with cooling Delta breezes in the evening, and winter can bring Central Valley tule fog.

eventVenues: Carnegie Museum of Art and Natural History
pittsburgh-pa.blurb: Pittsburgh's event calendar draws on healthcare, robotics, AI and higher education, with Carnegie Mellon, Pitt and UPMC fueling a steady stream of conferences. The city's rivers, bridges and hills give it varied backdrops; fall foliage is a highlight, while winters are cold and often overcast.

conferenceVenues: William A. Egan Civic and Convention Center
anchorage-ak.blurb: Anchorage hosts oil and gas, aviation, military and Alaska Native organization meetings, and summer destination weddings with mountain and inlet views. Long summer daylight gives photographers extended golden hours, while winter days are short and cold, so outdoor shoot windows shift dramatically by season.

cincinnati-oh.blurb: Cincinnati is headquarters to Procter & Gamble, Kroger and other major firms, so consumer-goods, retail and financial meetings fill its convention center and downtown hotels. Historic architecture in Over-the-Rhine and along the Ohio River makes for strong backdrops, with spring and fall the most comfortable outdoor seasons.

conferenceVenues: Green Valley Ranch Resort Spa and Casino
The Westin Lake Las Vegas Resort & Spa
Hilton Lake Las Vegas Resort & Spa
eventVenues: Green Valley Ranch Resort Spa and Casino
The Westin Lake Las Vegas Resort & Spa
photoSpots: Ethel M Chocolates Botanical Cactus Garden
henderson-nv.blurb: Henderson offers a quieter, resort-style alternative to the Las Vegas Strip, with lakeside and casino resorts hosting corporate retreats, incentive groups and weddings. Desert conditions mean very hot summers, so outdoor shoots are best planned for fall through spring or at sunrise and sunset.

eventVenues: Steven Tanger Center for the Performing Arts
greensboro-nc.blurb: Greensboro's history in textiles and its role in the 1960 sit-in movement shape its cultural events, while its coliseum complex and several universities draw tournaments, trade shows and academic meetings. Spring and fall are prime seasons for outdoor work, with mild winters and warm, humid summers.

eventVenues: Marjorie McNeely Conservatory at Como Park
saint-paul-mn.blurb: As Minnesota's capital, Saint Paul hosts government, association and healthcare meetings, along with the Saint Paul Winter Carnival and the nearby Minnesota State Fair. Victorian homes, river bluffs and historic downtown buildings make strong backdrops, with summer and fall best for outdoor sessions and indoor venues favored through the cold winter.

conferenceVenues: Renaissance Dallas at Plano Legacy West Hotel
Dallas/Plano Marriott at Legacy Town Center
photoSpots: Oak Point Park and Nature Preserve
plano-tx.blurb: Plano is home to the corporate headquarters of companies such as Toyota North America and JCPenney, which keeps its Legacy business district busy with corporate meetings and product events. North Texas weather favors spring and fall for outdoor shoots, as summers are very hot and spring brings storm risk.

eventVenues: Cathedral Basilica of the Sacred Heart
photoSpots: Cathedral Basilica of the Sacred Heart
newark-nj.blurb: Newark combines insurance, logistics, higher education and arts institutions, so its venues host corporate meetings, university events and performances within easy reach of Manhattan. Branch Brook Park's cherry blossoms make April a standout month for outdoor portraits, while summers are hot and winters cold.

eventVenues: Toledo Museum of Art and Glass Pavilion
toledo-oh.blurb: Toledo is known as the Glass City for its glassmaking heritage, and its convention center, art museum and riverfront host manufacturing, automotive and regional association events. Summer and early fall are best for outdoor shoots along the Maumee River, while winters are cold with lake-effect clouds.

lincoln-ne.blurb: Lincoln's event calendar is driven by state government, the University of Nebraska and Husker football weekends, which fill hotels each fall. Spring and fall bring the most comfortable outdoor weather, while summers are hot and winters cold and windy.

eventVenues: Dr. Phillips Center for the Performing Arts
Albin Polasek Museum & Sculpture Gardens (Winter Park)
orlando-fl.blurb: Orlando is one of the country's busiest convention destinations, with the Orange County Convention Center and theme-park resorts hosting trade shows, incentive trips and destination weddings year-round. Winter and spring are the most comfortable months for outdoor sessions; summers bring heat, humidity and near-daily afternoon thunderstorms.

chula-vista-ca.blurb: Chula Vista's bayfront became a major meetings destination with the 2025 opening of the Gaylord Pacific Resort & Convention Center, adding large-scale conference space to the South Bay. The coastal climate is mild year-round, with late-spring marine layer mornings and dependably clear fall days for outdoor work.

conferenceVenues: Hyatt Regency Jersey City on the Hudson
eventVenues: Hyatt Regency Jersey City on the Hudson
Canopy by Hilton Jersey City Arts District
jersey-city-nj.blurb: Jersey City's waterfront financial district hosts banking, insurance and tech meetings with the Manhattan skyline as a backdrop, and Liberty State Park is a favorite for wedding portraits facing the Statue of Liberty. Spring and fall offer the best outdoor light and comfort, with hot summers and cold, windy waterfront winters.

conferenceVenues: Sheraton Grand at Wild Horse Pass
eventVenues: Sheraton Grand at Wild Horse Pass
photoSpots: Historic Downtown Chandler and Dr. A.J. Chandler Park
chandler-az.blurb: Chandler is a semiconductor and tech hub in the Phoenix area, with Intel's large campus and the Price Corridor generating corporate meetings and product events. Outdoor shoots are best from October through April, since summer temperatures regularly top 105°F and the monsoon season adds dust storms and lightning.

conferenceVenues: Hilton Fort Wayne at the Grand Wayne Convention Center
fort-wayne-in.blurb: Fort Wayne's economy rests on manufacturing, healthcare, insurance and defense, and its revitalized riverfront downtown draws regional conferences, festivals and weddings. Summers are warm and green with the Lakeside rose garden in bloom from June, while winters are cold and snowy.

conferenceVenues: Hyatt Regency Buffalo Hotel and Conference Center
eventVenues: Buffalo and Erie County Botanical Gardens
buffalo-ny.blurb: Buffalo's architectural legacy, from Frank Lloyd Wright houses to Olmsted parks, shapes its event scene alongside healthcare, education and advanced manufacturing meetings. Summers along the waterfront are pleasant and popular for weddings, while lake-effect snow makes indoor venues the norm in winter.

durham-nc.blurb: Durham's events draw on Duke University, Duke Health and nearby Research Triangle Park, with converted tobacco warehouses now serving as venues for conferences, galas and weddings. Spring blooms at Duke Gardens and mild fall weather are peak times for outdoor sessions, while summers are hot and humid.

conferenceVenues: The Vinoy Resort & Golf Club, Autograph Collection
eventVenues: Museum of Fine Arts, St. Petersburg
James Museum of Western & Wildlife Art
st-petersburg-fl.blurb: St. Petersburg pairs a museum-rich downtown waterfront with Gulf beaches, making it a draw for association meetings, arts events and destination weddings. Winter and spring offer comfortable, drier weather and clear sunsets, while summer brings heat, afternoon storms and hurricane-season planning.

conferenceVenues: Beckman Center of the National Academies of Sciences & Engineering
irvine-ca.blurb: Irvine is a master-planned business hub with tech, biotech, automotive and gaming companies, plus UC Irvine, so corporate meetings and offsites make up much of its event calendar. Mild Southern California weather allows outdoor shoots nearly year-round, with spring green hills and clear fall days the best windows.

eventVenues: Republic of the Rio Grande Museum
photoSpots: Lake Casa Blanca International State Park
laredo-tx.blurb: Laredo is one of the busiest land ports on the U.S.-Mexico border, so trade, logistics and customs-related meetings anchor its business events, and the George Washington's Birthday Celebration is a signature winter tradition. Summers are very hot, so outdoor sessions are best from late fall through early spring.

eventVenues: Buddy Holly Hall of Performing Arts and Sciences
photoSpots: Buddy and Maria Elena Holly Plaza
lubbock-tx.blurb: Lubbock's event scene is driven by Texas Tech University, agriculture, cotton and the growing High Plains wine industry, with the Depot District offering music and nightlife venues. Wide skies make for long sunsets, but spring winds and dust and hot summer afternoons favor early-morning or evening outdoor sessions.

conferenceVenues: Monona Terrace Community and Convention Center
madison-wi.blurb: As Wisconsin's capital and home of the University of Wisconsin-Madison, the city hosts government, academic, healthcare-tech and association events, with Epic Systems in nearby Verona adding a major corporate presence. The isthmus between two lakes is at its best in summer and early fall, while winters are long and cold.

conferenceVenues: Sheraton Grand at Wild Horse Pass
Phoenix Marriott Resort Tempe at The Buttes
gilbert-az.blurb: Gilbert's event calendar leans toward family celebrations, school and church functions, and farm-style weddings, with larger corporate meetings usually held in neighboring Mesa, Chandler or Tempe. Outdoor shoots work best from October through April, since summer afternoons regularly top 105°F.

norfolk-va.blurb: Norfolk's events are shaped by Naval Station Norfolk, the port and the region's defense contractors, alongside Old Dominion University and festivals like Harborfest on the downtown waterfront. Summers are hot and humid and hurricane season runs June through November, so waterfront shoots benefit from a weather backup plan.

louisville-ky.blurb: Louisville hosts a steady run of trade shows at the Kentucky Exposition Center plus healthcare, logistics and bourbon-industry events, and the Kentucky Derby on the first Saturday in May fills hotels and venues weeks in advance. Spring and fall are the most comfortable seasons for outdoor portraits; summers are humid.

eventVenues: Wilbur D. May Arboretum and Botanical Garden
photoSpots: Truckee River Walk and Wingfield Park
reno-nv.blurb: Reno combines casino-resort conventions with a growing tech and logistics economy, and its summer calendar includes Hot August Nights and the Great Reno Balloon Race in September. The high-desert climate brings dry, sunny days but cold, sometimes snowy winters, and Lake Tahoe is a common add-on location for couples.

eventVenues: Reynolda House Museum of American Art
Milton Rhodes Center for the Arts
photoSpots: Downtown Arts District on Trade Street
winston-salem-nc.blurb: Winston-Salem's events draw on Wake Forest University, Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist and the Innovation Quarter, along with arts programming such as the RiverRun International Film Festival. Its historic estates and gardens are popular for spring and fall weddings, when Piedmont weather is mild.

photoSpots: Historic Downtown Glendale and Catlin Court
glendale-az.blurb: Glendale's Westgate area brings in major sporting events at State Farm Stadium, including NFL games and past Super Bowls, along with conferences at the adjoining Renaissance hotel and spring training at Camelback Ranch. The cooler months from October to April are the prime outdoor season, and Glendale Glitters lights up downtown each winter.

eventVenues: Milander Center for Arts and Entertainment
photoSpots: Hialeah Park and its flamingo flock
hialeah-fl.blurb: Hialeah is a predominantly Cuban-American city where quinceañeras, family milestones and church weddings make up much of the event calendar, with corporate meetings typically held near Miami International Airport and Doral. Expect heat, humidity and afternoon storms from June through October; winter and spring offer the most reliable outdoor light.

conferenceVenues: Kay Bailey Hutchison Convention Center Dallas
eventVenues: The Atrium at Granville Arts Center
garland-tx.blurb: Garland's events range from school and community gatherings at the Curtis Culwell Center to performances and receptions at the Granville Arts Center, with larger conventions heading to nearby Dallas. North Texas summers are very hot and spring brings severe-storm risk, so fall is the easiest season for outdoor sessions.

conferenceVenues: JW Marriott Scottsdale Camelback Inn Resort & Spa
Hyatt Regency Scottsdale Resort & Spa at Gainey Ranch
eventVenues: Four Seasons Resort Scottsdale at Troon North
scottsdale-az.blurb: Scottsdale is a resort-based meetings destination for incentive trips and executive retreats, and its January–February calendar includes the Barrett-Jackson car auction and the WM Phoenix Open at TPC Scottsdale. Peak wedding and conference season runs October through April, with desert sunsets and saguaro backdrops a short drive from most resorts.

conferenceVenues: Irving Convention Center at Las Colinas
The Westin Irving Convention Center at Las Colinas
Four Seasons Resort and Club Dallas at Las Colinas
eventVenues: Four Seasons Resort and Club Dallas at Las Colinas
photoSpots: Mustangs at Las Colinas in Williams Square
irving-tx.blurb: Irving's Las Colinas district is a corporate hub home to several Fortune 500 headquarters, and its convention center sits minutes from DFW Airport, which makes it a common choice for national sales meetings. Spring and fall are the best seasons for outdoor work; summer heat pushes most events indoors.

photoSpots: Great Dismal Swamp National Wildlife Refuge
chesapeake-va.blurb: Chesapeake's events are a mix of military-family celebrations, community festivals and business meetings in the Greenbrier corridor, with Norfolk and Virginia Beach close by for larger conventions. Its wooded parks and waterways suit spring and fall portraits, while summers are humid and hurricane season runs June through November.

photoSpots: Tule Springs Fossil Beds National Monument
Floyd Lamb Park at Tule Springs
north-las-vegas-nv.blurb: North Las Vegas is a fast-growing suburb whose own events center on community celebrations, Nellis Air Force Base families and the Aliante area, while major conventions sit 20–30 minutes south on the Strip. Spring and fall bring the best shooting weather; summer highs routinely pass 105°F.

fremont-ca.blurb: Fremont sits at the East Bay edge of Silicon Valley, with Tesla's factory and many tech and manufacturing firms generating corporate events, and a large South Asian community that keeps multi-day weddings in steady demand. The mild climate allows year-round shoots, and Mission Peak's hills turn green after winter rains.

baton-rouge-la.blurb: As Louisiana's capital and home to LSU, Baton Rouge hosts legislative, petrochemical-industry and university events, and fall Saturdays revolve around Tiger Stadium. Live oaks and River Road plantation homes are popular wedding backdrops; plan around summer humidity and hurricane season.

conferenceVenues: Lexington Griffin Gate Marriott Golf Resort & Spa
photoSpots: Horse farms along Old Frankfort Pike
Arboretum State Botanical Garden of Kentucky
lexington-ky.blurb: Lexington's event scene is tied to the horse industry, bourbon tourism and the University of Kentucky, with Keeneland's April and October race meets setting the social calendar. Spring and fall bring green pastures and mild temperatures that suit horse-farm and estate weddings.

photoSpots: Welcome to Fabulous Las Vegas sign
Red Rock Canyon National Conservation Area
paradise-nv.blurb: The unincorporated town of Paradise contains most of the Las Vegas Strip, so it hosts the bulk of the region's mega-conventions such as CES and dozens of other large trade shows, plus a constant stream of destination weddings. Strip casinos offer controlled indoor settings year-round, while outdoor desert sessions are best scheduled for cooler mornings or the fall-to-spring season.

richmond-va.blurb: Richmond's events come from state government, finance, healthcare and VCU, while its breweries, historic districts and riverfront draw a growing number of weddings. Spring and fall bring the best weather and foliage along the James River; summers are hot and humid.

conferenceVenues: Yaamava' Resort & Casino at San Manuel
eventVenues: California Theatre of the Performing Arts
Yaamava' Resort & Casino at San Manuel
photoSpots: Rim of the World Scenic Byway
san-bernardino-ca.blurb: San Bernardino is a logistics and government center for the Inland Empire, and many of its corporate and celebration events cluster around Hospitality Lane and the casino resort in neighboring Highland. Summer valley heat is intense, but the San Bernardino Mountains are less than an hour away for cooler, forested backdrops.

photoSpots: Bowl and Pitcher in Riverside State Park
spokane-wa.blurb: Spokane is the regional hub of the Inland Northwest, hosting healthcare, education and agriculture conferences, and its Bloomsday run in May and Hoopfest in June draw large crowds downtown. Summers are warm and dry with long evenings while winters are snowy, so most outdoor weddings fall between May and October.

conferenceVenues: Hyatt Regency Birmingham – The Wynfrey Hotel
Renaissance Birmingham Ross Bridge Golf Resort & Spa
birmingham-al.blurb: Birmingham's meetings draw on UAB's medical center, banking and engineering, and the city hosts civil-rights heritage tourism and events at Protective Stadium and the BJCC. Spring blooms and fall color are prime for outdoor shoots; summers are hot and humid with frequent afternoon storms.

modesto-ca.blurb: Modesto sits in the agricultural heart of the Central Valley, so food-processing, winery and farm-industry events are common alongside celebrations in the downtown arts district. Valley summers are hot and dry, while spring brings orchard blossoms that work well as wedding and engagement backdrops.

conferenceVenues: Embassy Suites by Hilton Des Moines Downtown
photoSpots: John and Mary Pappajohn Sculpture Park
des-moines-ia.blurb: Des Moines is an insurance and financial-services center, which drives a steady stream of corporate meetings, and the Iowa State Fair each August is one of the state's biggest annual gatherings. Midwestern winters are cold, so most outdoor weddings and portraits happen from May through October.

conferenceVenues: Joseph A. Floreano Rochester Riverside Convention Center
Del Monte Lodge Renaissance Rochester Hotel & Spa
eventVenues: The Strong National Museum of Play
rochester-ny.airport: Frederick Douglass Greater Rochester International Airport (ROC)
rochester-ny.blurb: Rochester's events reflect its optics, imaging and healthcare industries, the University of Rochester and RIT, and May's Lilac Festival in Highland Park. Lake-effect snow makes winters long, so outdoor weddings and portraits typically run from late spring through early fall foliage.

tacoma-wa.blurb: Tacoma's event market is shaped by the Port of Tacoma, Joint Base Lewis-McChord and a strong museum district, which makes it a practical alternative to Seattle for conferences and receptions. Rain is common from October to May, so summer is peak outdoor season, with Mount Rainier views on clear days.

conferenceVenues: Hyatt Regency Crystal City at Reagan National Airport
arlington-va.blurb: Arlington's events are driven by the federal government, defense contractors and Amazon's HQ2 in National Landing, with frequent association and government meetings near the Pentagon and Reagan National. Its overlooks of the Potomac and the DC skyline are popular for portraits, especially during spring cherry-blossom season and in fall.

photoSpots: Martin Tudor Jurupa Hills Regional Park
fontana-ca.blurb: Fontana grew from a steel town into a logistics and warehousing hub, and its events are mostly community celebrations, quinceañeras and family weddings, with conventions held next door in Ontario. Summers are hot and smoggy at times, so cooler months and golden-hour sessions in the foothills work best.

conferenceVenues: Embassy Suites by Hilton Mandalay Beach Resort
Oxnard Performing Arts and Convention Center
eventVenues: Embassy Suites by Hilton Mandalay Beach Resort
oxnard-ca.blurb: Oxnard's economy rests on agriculture, the Port of Hueneme and Naval Base Ventura County, and its May Strawberry Festival and harbor events anchor the local calendar. Coastal fog is common in late spring and early summer, while fall usually brings the clearest beach light.

moreno-valley-ca.blurb: Moreno Valley is a growing Inland Empire city anchored by distribution centers, Riverside University Health System and March Air Reserve Base, with most of its events being family celebrations and community gatherings. Hot, dry summers make spring wildflower season around Lake Perris and the cooler months the easiest times for outdoor shoots.

conferenceVenues: Embassy Suites by Hilton Fayetteville & Richard M. Wiggins Conference Center
fayetteville-nc.blurb: Fayetteville is home to Fort Bragg, one of the largest military installations in the country, so promotions, military balls, homecomings and quick-turnaround weddings are a big part of local event work. Spring azaleas and dogwoods are a highlight; summers are hot and humid.

conferenceVenues: Hyatt Regency Huntington Beach Resort & Spa
The Waterfront Beach Resort, a Hilton Hotel
eventVenues: Hyatt Regency Huntington Beach Resort & Spa
The Waterfront Beach Resort, a Hilton Hotel
huntington-beach-ca.blurb: Known as Surf City USA, Huntington Beach hosts the US Open of Surfing each summer and a steady flow of beachfront corporate retreats and weddings at its oceanfront resorts. Morning marine layer ("May Gray" and "June Gloom") is common in early summer, so sunset sessions and fall dates often give the clearest skies.

eventVenues: The Fermenting Cellar in the Distillery District
toronto-on.blurb: Toronto is Canada's financial and media capital, hosting large conferences at the Metro Toronto Convention Centre and Exhibition Place and drawing international attention every September during the Toronto International Film Festival. Summer and early fall are peak wedding season, and winter events move indoors to the city's hotels, museums and converted industrial spaces.

photoSpots: Mount Royal and the Kondiaronk Belvedere
montreal-qc.blurb: Montréal is a major host city for international association congresses, aerospace, AI and life-sciences meetings, and its summer festivals, including the Jazz Festival and Just for Laughs, fill the calendar from June to August. Bilingual coverage is often needed, and winters are cold and snowy, so outdoor weddings concentrate between June and early October.

conferenceVenues: Delta Hotels by Marriott Ottawa City Centre
photoSpots: Dow's Lake and the Central Experimental Farm
ottawa-on.blurb: As Canada's capital, Ottawa hosts government, diplomatic, association and tech-sector meetings, and its calendar includes the Canadian Tulip Festival in May, Canada Day on Parliament Hill and Winterlude in February. Spring tulips and fall colour in nearby Gatineau Park are favourite backdrops, while winters are cold and snowy.

mississauga-on.blurb: Mississauga hosts many corporate head offices and trade shows near Pearson Airport, which sits within the city, and its diverse population keeps South Asian, Chinese and Middle Eastern weddings in high demand. Lakeshore parks in Port Credit are popular from late spring to fall, and large banquet halls handle events year-round.

north-york-on.blurb: North York's office towers along Yonge Street and York University generate steady corporate and academic events, and its large Korean, Persian, Chinese and Jewish communities support a busy wedding and celebration calendar. Edwards Gardens and the Toronto Botanical Garden are favourite portrait spots from May through October.

conferenceVenues: Delta Hotels by Marriott Toronto East
eventVenues: Delta Hotels by Marriott Toronto East
scarborough-on.blurb: Scarborough is one of Toronto's most diverse areas, so much of its event work is multicultural weddings, banquets and community celebrations, along with university events at U of T Scarborough. The Scarborough Bluffs along Lake Ontario are a signature backdrop in summer and early fall, ideally photographed at sunrise or late afternoon.

conferenceVenues: Centre de foires de Québec at ExpoCité
eventVenues: Musée national des beaux-arts du Québec
quebec-qc.airport: Québec City Jean Lesage International Airport (YQB)
quebec-qc.blurb: Québec City's walled old town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, makes it a popular choice for association meetings and destination weddings, and its calendar includes the Winter Carnival in February and the Festival d'été in July. French is the primary language of business, and winters are snowy, which also creates distinctive winter-wedding opportunities.

hamilton-on.airport: Toronto Pearson International Airport (YYZ); John C. Munro Hamilton International Airport (YHM) is closer
hamilton-on.blurb: Hamilton has shifted from steel toward healthcare, education and the arts, with McMaster University and a lively James Street North art scene driving many of its events. The Niagara Escarpment gives the city dozens of waterfalls that photograph best in spring runoff and fall colour.

brampton-on.blurb: Brampton has one of Canada's largest South Asian communities, which makes large multi-day weddings, sangeets and receptions at its convention-style banquet halls the core of local event work. Summer is peak season for outdoor baraat processions and park portraits, and many events run late into the evening, so plan for low-light coverage.

photoSpots: Centre de la nature de Laval
laval-qc.blurb: Laval, just north of Montréal across the Rivière des Prairies, has large reception halls that host weddings, galas and corporate meetings for the wider Montréal region, much of it conducted in French. The Mille-Îles river and the historic village of Sainte-Rose make good summer and fall backdrops; winters are cold and snowy.
